content.text: Alternatives: clindamycin 300 mg PO BID x7 days or clindamycin ovules 100 mg intravaginally at bedtime x3 days; secnidazole 2 g oral granules, single dose; tinidazole 2 g PO daily x2 days or 1 g daily x5 days
Clindamycin ovules can weaken latex condoms and diaphragms for 72 h
